About this analysis

Flip markers show completed daily closes crossing a specified level; they do not confirm a retest. The volume profile distributes each candle’s ETH volume evenly across its high–low range. It is an estimate, not trade-level volume-at-price.

Levels & alert settings

Set all six chart levels in USD, then choose which levels trigger alerts. Proximity and daily-volume confirmation are optional.

Price levels · USD

Use positive amounts with up to two decimals, ordered S3 < S2 < S1 < R1 < R2 < R3.

Levels that trigger alerts

Select at least one level. All six saved prices remain visible on the chart.

Daily modes use completed UTC candles. Retests require a touch within ±0.25% of the level in one of the next five completed daily candles, then a close beyond it.

A new alert requires a return inside the level and a later breach. Cooldown applies to each rule and direction.

Optional confirmations

Use a positive percentage. Proximity alerts use fresh quotes before a level is breached, with the same per-rule cooldown.

Available in daily-close or retest mode. The signal candle must have at least 1.5× the average volume of the preceding 20 completed daily candles.
